Im not usually the person who posts a 1 ⭐️ but I really feel it’s important for people to know The Boulevard location in Staten Island has really gone down hill. I will begin with the staff shortage that’s been going on for months. Awhile back, my daughter’s dog was injured. She was not bit by another dog but came out with a huge deep gash in her face that has left a scar. It looks like she got caught on something. “The cameras weren’t working” so no one knows what happened to her. Then my son dropped his dog off a few weeks ago for an overnight stay. He gave them one package of refrigerated food for the dog. That covered 2 meals. He received the food returned warm and unopened. The dog was never fed in 24 hours! Today, after making an appointment, & getting a confirmation for my dog to attend all day, day camp, he was denied entrance because they were full to capacity. What’s the point of an appointment and a confirmation? Im not taking any more chances with this place.
Amazing place friendly staff and my dog loves it here! Definitely worth 5 stars if not more 👍🏼 …
